Strided array sections are allowed in target update motion clauses. The data-motion clause assigns only the list item's elements, so a(2),a(4),... and b(5:8) must keep their host values. The target region maps a,b already present (target data), so no copy at its end. The observed result copies the whole array, which is not permitted.

Copying the contiguous range instead overwrites even elements with 12,14,16,18, which is a compiler bug.
